arena: [생존기] Cloak of Shadows instantly removes all harmful spell effects and resists harmful spells for 5 sec. Use it when enemy casters send CC spells or magic burst.
[생존기] With Preemptive Maneuver, Feint grants an extra 25% damage reduction while you're stunned and costs 30% less Energy. Pop Feint right before you get stunned.
[제어] Shadow Dance lets you use Stealth abilities in combat for 6 sec. Land Cheap Shot's 6 sec stun on the enemy healer mid-combat and burst with Shadow Blades.
[제어] Kidney Shot lasts longer with more combo points, up to an 8 sec stun. Use it the moment the enemy healer or your kill target has no defensives up.
[제어] Blind disorients the target for 1 min but damage can break it. Put it on the enemy healer and have your team attack another target.
[분담] Smoke Bomb creates an 8 yd smoke cloud around you for 5 sec, and enemies can't target into or out of it. Drop it next to your kill target so the enemy healer outside can't heal them.
[차단] Kick interrupts a cast and locks that school for 6 sec. Shadowstep behind a target up to 25 yds away and time it to the enemy healer's heal casts.
[생존기] Evasion increases your dodge chance by 100% for 10 sec, and Dismantle disarms an enemy's weapon and shield for 5 sec. Alternate them when melee DPS pop burst cooldowns and get on you.
bg: [참고] Stealth classes are good at base defense. Hide in Stealth next to the base flag you're guarding, then Cheap Shot enemies that come to capture for a 6 sec stun.
[참고] Per map rules, a flag carrier that stealths drops the flag. Don't use Vanish or Stealth while holding the flag.
[분담] In Rated Battlegrounds, when the middle teamfight is lost, stealthy DPS sneak to enemy bases. Sap an out-of-combat base defender for 1 min and go for the capture.
[분담] With Silhouette, Shadowstep used on an ally has a 67% shorter cooldown. Jump straight to your focused flag carrier and protect them.
[생존기] Healing taken is reduced by 20% in battlegrounds. Rather than waiting on heals, use Feint, Evasion and Cloak of Shadows right before the burst.
[제어] Enemies disoriented by Blind can't be knocked back. Use it on enemies trying to capture a base, but don't overlap it with your team's knockbacks.
